subject: Post-call recap: procurement & marketplace purchase routes for ApexCare
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
To: Ellen Shaw <ellen@apexcare.io>

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement & marketplace purchase routes for ApexCare

Hi Ellen — great to chat this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and timing.

Key notes from the call:
- ApexCare is interested in Redwood for patient-facing summaries and clinical document ingestion.
- Primary goal: predictable monthly billing for pilot, eventual annual commitment.
- Procurement preference today: likely PO for pilot but team is open to AWS Marketplace Private Offer if that speeds procurement.
- Internal procurement contact: Samir Patel (procurement@apexcare.io) per your note.

Action items / asks from ApexCare:
1) Please confirm preferred buying lane: (A) Direct PO to Redwood, (B) Card for fast pilot, or (C) AWS Marketplace private offer (PO via marketplace). If you pick C, let us know whether you require a Private Offer or Standard listing.
2) Procurement timeline and target signing date (rough window is fine).
3) Billing entity and legal contact for contract redlines.
4) Any vendor questionnaire / security checklist we should fill now (SOC2 artifact requests, data residency notes).

What we’ll do from Redwood:
- Share a short PO vs Marketplace comparison matrix and a pricing sheet tailored to pilot usage (attached).
- If marketplace is preferred, Aditya will start onboarding and share the required marketplace paperwork and timelines.
- If PO route, Marissa will outline net terms and invoice cadence.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub), rw-pricing-cloud-matrix.pdf (stub)

Proposed next call: 30-minute session with Samir + legal on the procurement path. Are you available next week Thu 8/12 or Fri 8/13?

Thanks again — will wait for your preference and timeline so we can lock internal resources.

Best,
Priyom

From: Ellen Shaw <ellen@apexcare.io>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement & marketplace purchase routes for ApexCare

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below and a couple of clarifying questions.

We are leaning toward option C — AWS Marketplace private offer — because our finance team prefers buying via marketplace when possible (consolidates invoicing) and it shortens procurement approvals. That said, for an immediate proof-of-concept we may accept a one-off monthly PO while marketplace onboarding completes.

High-level timeline: procurement kickoff this week with Samir; target to sign pilot paperwork in 6–8 weeks assuming no major contract redlines.

Procurement contacts:
- Primary procurement: Samir Patel (procurement@apexcare.io) — looping him here.
- Legal: Jordan Mills (jordan.mills@apexcare.io) — we may need to share your standard DPA and contract template.

Questions for Redwood:
1) What is the typical lead time to get a Private Offer listed on AWS Marketplace once paperwork is submitted?
2) If we go PO for the pilot, can Redwood invoice ApexCare monthly with Net 30?

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, 4 Aug 2026 at 10:15 AM Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Hi Ellen — great to chat this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and timing.

Team — forwarding Ellen’s reply. Summary & asks so we can move quickly:

Summary:
- ApexCare prefers AWS Marketplace Private Offer for consolidation, but will accept a short-term monthly PO to start the pilot.
- Procurement timeline: 6–8 weeks expected. Procurement lead is Samir; legal is Jordan.

Please action below:
- Aditya: please pull together the marketplace onboarding checklist and expected SLA for Private Offer listing. Highlight typical lead time and required documents (tax forms, commercial terms, listing manifest). Target: share checklist by EOD 8/5.
- Marissa: prepare a PO vs Marketplace price/cost delta matrix (monthly pilot pricing with invoice cadence and any marketplace fee assumptions). Tag whether Net 30 is available for PO invoicing. Target: draft by 8/6.
- Karthik: schedule a 30-min slot with Samir + Jordan next week to walk the procurement path; propose Thu 8/12 10:00–10:30 or Fri 8/13 9:30–10:00.

Also: Laura, please hold for any legal questions — we may need a short DPA/contract teed up if Jordan asks.

Note: attachments sent to the customer were the mutual-action-plan and cloud pricing matrix (stubs). I’ll send a lightweight one-pager for procurement that highlights security artifacts we can share.

Thanks — aiming to keep this moving and lower friction for the team.

Priyom

3) Doc links: we’ve uploaded a short mutual action plan and pricing matrix here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bRW-apexcare-mop

Proposed meeting: Thu 2026-08-12 10:00–10:30 PT (we’ll send a calendar invite once Samir confirms).

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this scheduled.
